svg.title: ACORN in the research ecosystem
svg.desc: Twelve research ecosystem elements form a circle: PIDs, artifacts, people, organizations, repositories, services, GitLab runners, bots, servers, workflows, metadata, and standards. A thin dashed Graphite rim represents loose connections among ecosystem elements. Strong ORNL Green routes cross the circle through ACORN, with opposing Biome arrowheads representing dynamic two-way exchange and shortcuts between disparate elements. Connections are conceptual, not a list of implemented integrations. The background is transparent.
